attributes.description: tall, snow-dusted, jagged peak with sheer cliff faces, partially covered in snow, bathed in warm, golden glow of setting sun, dramatic chiaroscuro effect, highly detailed texture with cracks, striations, and weathered stone

cluster of traditional red wooden fishing cabins with white trim and sloped roofs, built on rocky, snow-covered shoreline, arranged in staggered, organic pattern, some with visible windows and doors, one with red flag fluttering in wind
rocky, snow-covered shoreline with patches of exposed dark rock and seaweed, wooden walkways and railings connecting cabins, turbulent, frothy ocean waves crashing against shore with motion blur
deep, vivid blue water with white foam, contrasting with red cabins and white snow, surface reflects fading light, adding depth and luminosity

soft, purple-blue twilight sky with distant snow-capped peaks fading into it, transitioning from soft lavender to deep indigo, cinematic lighting with warm, golden hour light illuminating mountain and cabins
